Pasteback 0.5.1 — Quieter when idle / 空闲时更安静
Releases quick-panel and workspace views when hidden, closed or minimized. Search and selected-item state stay available when the workspace reopens. Clipboard monitoring continues in the background. Includes the 0.5 quick-access panel, custom shortcuts, pinned sections and optional automatic-paste setup.
浮层隐藏、工作窗口关闭或最小化时释放界面资源，重新打开仍保留搜索与选择，后台继续记录。包含 0.5 的快捷浮层、自定义快捷键、固定项置顶及可选自动粘贴引导。
This testing release is not Apple notarized. Clipboard history remains local and is preserved during updates. 此测试版尚未完成 Apple 公证；历史保留在本机，更新时保留。
